text:
rachel (marketing): Quick ask for launch: we need a validated bench pack for the blog + webinar. Focused slices: tiny (<=32t), short (<=128), chat (8-turn, ~32t each), long (2k). Requesting cold vs warm p50/p95, quantized vs fp16 deltas, and 500 raw logs per slice. Can you run a fast sweep and attach artifacts?

omar (eng-runtime): We can. Are regions needed? and which quant profiles?

rachel (marketing): us-west only for speed. Quant: q8_0 and fp16. Include reproducible seed and a manifest. Prioritize tiny and chat if it overruns.

meera (eng-runtime): Running with burst=10, sustained=3. Cold defined as first 20 after idle>=600s; warm after 3m sustain. We'll produce aggregated metrics and raw_token_logs.tar.gz.

ops-bot: started job launch-mini-sweep-1799998888; eta ~25m.

omar (eng-runtime): Command: python infra/bench.py --slices tiny,short,chat,long --samples 500 --profiles fp16,q8_0 --region us-west --burst 10 --sustained 3 --seed 123 --out /runs/launch_mini_1799998888

ops-bot: job launch-mini-sweep-1799998888 completed successfully. artifacts=/runs/launch_mini_1799998888.tar.gz

meera (eng-runtime): Upload: https://storage.internal/runs/launch_mini_1799998888.tar.gz. Highlights: tiny p95 fp16=38ms, q8_0=48ms (-~28% cost); chat p95 fp16=72ms, q8_0=86ms. Long p95 fp16=490ms, q8_0=610ms. Failures <0.2% and attributable to a node that hit IO during long runs.

omar (eng-runtime): Suggested slide blurb: "Quantized models reduce per-token cost by ~25-30% while modestly increasing p95 latency; short and chat workloads remain responsive for interactive demos."

rachel (marketing): Perfect. Please paste the manifest field list you included for footnotes.

meera (eng-runtime): Manifest fields: run_id, timestamp, git_sha, model_variant, quant_profile, region, slice_name, sample_count, seed, warm_window_s, cold_idle_s, raw_token_log_path, aggregated_metrics_path, checksum_sha256. All strings in the manifest inside the tar.gz.

rachel (marketing): Great — we'll flag you for a quick fact-check on the draft. Thanks! :sparkles:
